This is my card for **Take-home 6**. Full instructions and hints: [ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/data-science-ucsb/sports-stats-explorer/blob/main/ROADMAP.md#take-home-6-write-your-project-pitch)

## Steps
Add a "My work" section to my `members/<your-github-username>.md` file with:
- [ ] One sentence on what the project is
- [ ] What I built
- [ ] One interesting thing the data showed
- [ ] The link to my deployed dashboard from Take-home 5

Then:
- [ ] Open a pull request with `Closes #<this card's number>` in the description

## Done when
A friend who doesn't code can read it and understand what I did.

## When I'm finished
Nothing to do! The `Closes #...` line moves this card to **In review**, and to **Done** when a lead merges it.

**Challenge (optional):** write a resume bullet for this project (start with an action verb and include a number), and record a 60-second demo of your dashboard.
